about_short_description.short_description: EToro is a social trading and investment network that allows users to trade currencies, commodities, indices, crypto assets, and stocks.

product.name: eToro Trading and Investment Platform
product.description: A web and mobile platform for trading and investing in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, commodities, currencies, and indices across multiple global markets.

product.name: CopyTrader™
product.description: A social trading service that lets users automatically replicate the trades and portfolio activity of selected eToro investors in real time.

product.name: Stocks and ETFs Investing
product.description: A brokerage service providing access to shares and exchange-traded funds listed across global markets, with holdings managed through a single eToro account.

product.name: Cryptocurrency Trading
product.description: A service for buying, selling, holding, and managing supported cryptoassets through eToro, with access to more than 70 cryptoassets in the referenced market.

product.name: CFD Trading
product.description: A derivatives trading service that provides leveraged exposure to selected currencies, commodities, indices, stocks, and other markets without direct ownership of the underlying asset.

product.name: Investment Portfolios
product.description: Pre-constructed investment strategies that group multiple assets into diversified portfolios for investors who want a portfolio-based approach instead of selecting individual positions.
